CreateRoutineRequest.title: CreateRoutineRequest
CreateRoutineRequest.description:
Schedule life.review v1 at a fixed interval, with no external or model side effects.

next_due_at must include a timezone offset. A past time triggers a single coalesced review
when the host next ticks. enabled=false persists the routine without scheduling it.

allowed_commands.title: Allowed Commands
allowed_commands.description: Distinct argv arrays; duplicates are checked after text normalization.

available_shells.title: Available Shells
available_shells.description: Distinct shell names; duplicates are checked after text normalization.

ExecutionConfigRequest.title: ExecutionConfigRequest
ExecutionConfigRequest.description: Explicit confirmation of the host's credential-free execution settings.

StartWorkflowRequest.title: StartWorkflowRequest
StartWorkflowRequest.description:
Capture needs source_text and tasks; review reads this project and accepts neither.

Confirmation applies only to capture. Omitting it means true; false explicitly creates
the provided tasks immediately. Neither workflow executes the described life tasks.

UpdateLifeTaskRequest.title: UpdateLifeTaskRequest
UpdateLifeTaskRequest.description: Complete replacement of task-editable fields; null explicitly clears due_at.

UpdateProjectConfigurationRequest.title: UpdateProjectConfigurationRequest
UpdateProjectConfigurationRequest.description: A complete replacement: empty static_rules clears rules in the new version only.

UpdateRoutineRequest.title: UpdateRoutineRequest
UpdateRoutineRequest.description: Replace scheduling fields; completed runs retain their original schedule snapshot.
